pages.text: $(#8B0000)🔥 Infernal Forging · Demonic Brew 🔱$()$(br2)$(l)$(#8B0000)「Drink the blood of magma, let flesh become the fortress」$()$(br)When the toxicity of $(#800000)Nether Wart$() is neutralized by $(#DAA520)Gold Dust$(), and $(#4B0082)Warped Fungus$() and $(#8B0000)Crimson Fungus$() reach equilibrium in $(#CD5C5C)Lava Bubbles$()—a mystical concoction capable of $(l)granting resistance to infernal flames$() is complete.

$(#800000)▌ Twin Crowns of the Nether $()$(br2)$(l)$(#CD5C5C)🛡 Infernal Pact$()$(br)Even $(#FF4500)Lava Seas$() acknowledge your passage rights.$(br2)$(l)$(#8B0000)💀 Bone Reforging$()$(br)Bones harden to $(#696969)Obsidian-like density$().

$(br2)$(#4B0082)▌ Abyssal Crafting $()$(br)- Roast $(#800000)Nether Wart$() in a $(#8B0000)Infernal Furnace$() until the surface cracks.$(br)- Crush $(#4B0082)Fungal Threads$() with a $(#DAA520)Golden Hammer$() until they release a $(#483D8B)midnight-hued mist$().$(br)- When adding $(#8B0000)Crimson Extract$(), chant the $(#CD5C5C)Demonic Whisper$() to prevent the summoning of small demons.$(br2)$(#FF0000)⚠$() If the liquid turns $(#7CFC00)fluorescent green$(), discard immediately.

$(br2)$(#800000)『 Nether Inscription 』$()$(br)An ancient warning carved into $(#696969)Blackstone$():$(br)'Those who consume this $(#CD5C5C)Lava Essence$(),$(br)shall receive the $(#8B0000)blessing of the Inferno$() and the $(#4B0082)strength of the Piglins$()—$(br)but the $(#DAA520)golden glow$() will $(#696969)fade over time$(),$(br)and when the $(#483D8B)third eclipse$() arrives, $(br)those who over-rely on its power must return their gift to $(#FF4500)the Nether$().'
